name: vam-knowledge
description: Ticket-bound personal knowledge base: save what a session produced — an explanation, a draft of a message, a finding — into an Obsidian vault as a standalone document filed under its ticket, and recall it later by ticket, topic or full-text search. A follow-up save merges into the existing note instead of piling up duplicates. Vault-agnostic: the target vault is resolved at runtime from references/vaults.md, and mounted by a separate vam-vault-* connector plugin.
